messages:
emily-support: FYI — we have a customer escalation (ticket #12345) reporting repeated 502s and long stalls on hosted inference in eu-central starting ~09:12UTC. Graphs show gateway 5xx spike and tail latency. link: https://redwood.metrics/graphs/12345 :point_up:

liam: I see the spike in infra metrics too. TCP retransmits and dup acks up from 09:10->09:18. Major jump on egress interfaces in az1.

emily-support: Customer repro steps — simple curl to /v1/generate intermittently returns 502. Example response body: "upstream prematurely closed connection". They hit this from eu-west client.

ashley: Running quick traceroute to the customer IP from eu-central NAT egress — seeing asymmetric path and ECN marks. Suspect transit provider is doing a partial withdraw or reroute. Starting tcpdump on nat-gw and lb in az1.

ops-bot: tcpdump running on nat-gw-euc1-az1 for capture window 09:08-09:20. Saved to /pcap/5101010101-euc1-az1.pcap.

maria: Can we flip egress to provider-B as a mitigation? Provider-A looks to have micro-flaps. I'll prepare a controlled route preference change (canary 5% -> 50% -> 100%).

samir: Noted that runtime retry/fallback didn't kick in for some requests (tokens stalled). Would like to temporarily increase connection timeout at gateway so long requests don't fail hard while we stabilize egress.

emily-support: Sample gateway log from 2026-03-15T09:12:34Z:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:34Z] gateway: upstream error: connection reset by peer request_id=abc123 customer=acme-corp path=/v1/generate backend=upstream-a-10.2.3.4:8080
```

ashley: Flipped canary to provider-B (5% -> 50%). Monitoring egress retransmits and 5xx rate.

liam: Provider-A NOC confirmed they saw an intermittent BGP withdraw affecting a subset of prefixes in eu-central region at ~09:09-09:14 UTC. They've opened ticket NW-789 and are rolling a fix.

maria: After canary bump, 5xx rate decreased ~60% in az1 within 90s. We're holding the change for 10m to ensure stability, then will move to 100% if steady.

emily-support: Notifying impacted customers with interim mitigation note. Asking support to hold SLA credit calculations until postmortem.

samir: Pushed temporary gateway timeout bump from 10s -> 20s for /v1/generate route for eu-central to reduce hard failures while we wait for provider fix. Will revert in postmortem if not needed.

ashley: Collected BGP dumps, router logs, and pcaps. Uploading artifacts to the incident folder: https://redwood.incidents/5101010101/artifacts

liam: Provider confirmed root cause: flapping session to a transit peer causing transient withdraws and ECN marking leading to TCP tail retransmits. They applied a config to stabilize the peering. NOC ETA for full reconvergence 09:35 UTC.

emily-support: Thanks all. Customer updated. Can we get an owner for the postmortem? Need timeline, impact window, mitigation steps, and follow-up with provider for SLA credits.

maria: I'll own the postmortem. Action items: 1) collect PCAPs & BGP timeline (ashley), 2) provider comms (liam), 3) runtime/fallback tuning notes (samir), 4) customer impact & support notes (emily-support).

ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. 5xx rate trending down to baseline.

emily-support: Great. I'll prepare customer follow-up and draft the incident summary for tickets. :thumbsup:
